gloss: inside school grounds; on campus; within the school

definitions.gloss: inside school grounds; on campus; within the school
definitions.explanation: Refers to the area within a school's premises, including buildings, grounds, and facilities. Used as a location noun and as a modifier (校内の).

examples.japanese: {校内|こうない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited on school grounds.

examples.japanese: {校内|こうない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not use mobile phones inside the school.

examples.japanese: {校内|こうない}⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The school marathon event will be held next week.

examples.japanese: {校内|こうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{貼|は}ってあった→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: Posters for the school festival were put up on the bulletin board inside the school.

notes:
Part of a productive pattern where 内 (inside) attaches to place nouns: 校内, 社内, 院内, 市内, 国内, etc. Very common in school rules and announcements. The antonym is 校外 (outside school grounds).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {校内|こうない}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: school-wide broadcast/PA announcement
- {校内|こうない}⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧: school violence
- {校内|こうない}⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧: school rules
- {校内|こうない}⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧: school marathon
- {校内|こうない}⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: school newspaper
